description: POST a PxWeb query to a Moldova National Bureau of Statistics (Statbank) table and return observations as json-stat2. body must be {query:[{code, selection:{filter,values}}], response:{format:'json-stat2'}}. PxWeb caps responses at ~10,000 cells — narrow each dimension's values using codes from table_meta.

path.description: Path ending in the ".px" table id.

name: query_table
